datasets.name: Payments
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, creditid, paydate, payedamt, payedintamt, payeddueamt,
       payeddueintamt, payedpenaltyamt
  FROM cm_payments
WHERE CreditID=:CrdID
ORDER BY PayDate

datasets.name: Schedule
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, creditid, paymentdate, principal, interest
  FROM cm_payment_schedule
 WHERE CreditID=:CrdID
ORDER BY PaymentDate

datasets.name: PaymentData
datasets.sql:
select
p.id,b.name, 
p.numberofcredit,
cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(a.contractaccid) as acc_number,
ps.paymentdate,
ps.principal,
cm_ak_reports.get_pay(ps.creditid,ps.paymentdate) as paymentamount,
cm_ak_reports.get_payint(ps.creditid,ps.paymentdate) as PAYEDINTAMT,
cm_ak_reports.get_monthpayment(ps.creditid,ps.paymentdate) as mounthpay 
FROM 
cm_boorowerinfo b,
cm_active_credits p,
cm_payment_schedule ps,
cm_accounts a
where
b.creditid=p.id 
and p.id=ps.creditid 
and p.id=a.creditid

























order by ps.paymentdate

datasets.name: Customers
datasets.sql:
SELECT id,  name
  FROM CUSTOMERS
ORDER BY NAME

datasets.name: BoorDSet
datasets.sql: select name from cm_boorowerinfo group by name order by name

datasets.name: PortDSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT numberofcredit
  FROM cm_active_credits
group by numberofcredit
order by numberofcredit

datasets.name: PReserves
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, percent, description
  FROM cm_reserves
ORDER BY percent

datasets.name: SReserves
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, percent, description
  FROM cm_reserves
ORDER BY percent

datasets.name: UserGroups
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, description
  FROM cm_usergroups
order by description

datasets.name: AccDSet
datasets.sql:
select
cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(a.contractaccid) as acc_number
FROM 
cm_boorowerinfo b,
cm_accounts a
where
b.creditid=a.creditid
order by cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(a.contractaccid)

datasets.name: MusIdDSet
datasets.sql:
select
boorowerid
FROM 
cm_active_credits
group by boorowerid
order by boorowerid
